    Questions

    Everything you need to know before you book.

    Do I have to pay to pre-order?

    No. Placing a pre-order on this page does not take any online payment. Our team confirms pricing and eligibility with you on WhatsApp before anything is final.

    How do I get my company logo on the bottle?

    Choose "My company logo" while placing your order and upload your file to preview it on the label. We replace the IRA logo with yours at zero cost on eligible bulk orders. Our team confirms eligibility based on your volume.

    When is delivery free?

    Delivery is free on orders of more than 1,000 cases, and discounts are guaranteed on consistent monthly bulk orders of that size. For smaller orders, our team shares delivery terms when they confirm your pricing.

    Which sizes are available?

    IRA is launching in 1 Litre, 500 ml and 250 ml bottles. You order by the case, and our team confirms case sizes and pricing with you.

    How do samples work?

    A sample is 2 free bottles of one size. Choose "Sample request", pick the size and send it on WhatsApp. Our team confirms availability and delivery with you there.

    What size is the custom label, and which files can I upload?

    Our standard custom label is 20 mm high and 60 mm wide. Upload a PDF, JPG, PNG or SVG and you will see a preview at the right proportions, with a quick quality check. SVG and PDF files print the sharpest.

    Is IRA water safe and mineral enriched?

    IRA is backed by strict FSSAI certification standards and is 7x purified using advanced RO filtration, UV treatment and ozonation. It is infused with essential electrolytes for a crisp, refreshing taste.

    Are the bottles really recycled?

    Yes. IRA bottles use 100% food-grade safe recycled plastic (rPET) with zero virgin plastic. This cuts packaging carbon footprint by up to 79% and uses 76% less manufacturing energy than standard virgin plastic.

    How do I change or cancel my order?

    Message us on WhatsApp on 7861022128 with your reference and we will update or cancel it for you.

    I am a distributor. Can I order?

    Yes. Distributors and direct customers use the same form. Add your business name and send the order on WhatsApp.
